title: Proof-of-Work Record
description: Every agent output must carry this record. See Design Doc Section 6.

agent.description: The agent that produced this proof.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this proof relates to.

claim.description: What the agent claims to have done.

type.description: Kind of evidence: test_result, screenshot, log, build_log, diff, spec, etc.

ref.description: Path to the evidence file, relative to the run directory.

reasoning.description: Short reasoning note explaining the agent's decision.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this proof was created.
